items.title: What Should Costco Stock Holders Take From Its Fiscal Fourth Quarter?
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) stock rose 2.9% in the first session after its Q4 FY2026 report. The shares trade at 46.4 times earnings, more than twice the S&P 500's 21.9, so holders are counting on growth that keeps coming. What should a Costco holder take from a quarter that beat estimates and lifted the stock, yet left questions about whether its price cuts are driving more sales.

items.title: Kroger Boots Red Bull in High-Stakes Push for Everyday Low Prices
items.summary: Kroger  is playing hardball in its intensified pursuit of low prices, acting more like  Walmart  than a typical supermarket chain, Sarah Nassauer and Patrick Thomas report for The Wall Street Journal.  The grocer halted Red Bull orders around the beginning of August after the brand sought to raise its prices while offering a cheaper deal to a rival.  Red Bull displays are now gone from Kroger locations, and talks remain at a standstill.

items.title: Why Kroger Is Trying to Be More Like Walmart
items.summary: A hard-charging former Walmart executive who now helms Kroger has brought its emphasis on everyday low prices to his turnaround efforts.
